name: Last Days of Humanity
description:
'''Last Days of Humanity''' is a Dutch [[goregrind]] band from [[North Brabant]]. They were active from 1989 until 2006, releasing three studio albums between 1996 and 2006, and reformed in 2010. Their music is known for its relentless sound, featuring intense [[blast beat]]s delivered by drummer Marc Palmen.

The band is recognized as a significant act in the Dutch grindcore scene and is well-known for its contributions to the goregrind genre.
